items.title: Copyright and licensing
items.content: Authors keep the copyright. Northstar Labs publishes under CC BY-NC 4.0 and registers a DOI within 48 hours of acceptance. Using a paper in a thesis or in teaching needs no further permission.

items.title: Embargo and preprints
items.content: Preprints may stay on any server. The accepted version appears in the Lodestar archive on the issue date. The full text opens to all readers 12 months later.

items.title: Fees and reprint rights
items.content: There is no fee to submit or to publish. Commercial reprints of a single article are priced per print run. The rights desk replies within five working days.
